requirement_satisfaction.criteria: Delivery of action progression, dialogue fidelity, consequence tracking, and preserved unknowns.

source_fidelity.criteria: Faithfulness to established character voices (Doran, Lyra, Voss) and canon world constraints.

continuity.criteria: 1 if scene state naturally evolves from preceding scene; 0 if world state resets.

useful_novelty.criteria: Engaging tactical choices by characters consistent with their established Will.

correction_burden.criteria: Number of out-of-character actions or ungrounded resolutions requiring intervention.

reconstruction_burden.criteria: Effort to restore character relationships, inventories, and scene constraints.

recovery.criteria: 1 if tension and state resume cleanly after a cliffhanger pause; 0 otherwise.

forbidden_bias: Do not reward generic resolution if unknowns are collapsed prematurely.
